visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a graphic title card featuring the text '告白粉專' (Confession Pages) against a light blue, wavy background. A small cartoon logo of a person is in the upper left corner. (2) Five female students in matching uniforms—white shirts, pink vests, and red bows—are gathered in a school hallway. They whisper, smile, and giggle together, some holding their hands to their mouths in excitement. One girl is the center of attention as she shares a secret. (3) The scene cuts to three male students standing near a brick-walled window. One boy in a dark blue uniform holds a yellow smartphone and shouts enthusiastically. Another boy has a cartoonish ginger-haired head overlay. They are laughing and gesturing toward the female students. (4) The female students react with frustration and anger. They scowl and point at the boys, appearing offended by what was said. One girl speaks aggressively with high facial arousal before they walk away. (5) A second graphic title card appears with '養機場' (The Smartphone Farm) on a blue background. (6) In a classroom setting, a chaotic group of students is gathered around a numbered phone storage pouch on the wall. A teacher in a black shirt tries to organize them. One male student in a light blue uniform refuses to let go of his phone, speaking into it while others try to pry it away. (7) A stern female teacher enters the room, holding a portable speaker. She looks at the students with a cold, disgusted expression, causing them to freeze. The lighting is bright and indoor-focused throughout.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 5 female students, 3 main male students, 1 male teacher, 1 female teacher, and 3 additional students in the classroom.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: High school students in various uniforms; girls in pink vests and white shirts, boys in light blue or dark blue school shirts. A female teacher wearing a dark purple vest over a long-sleeved shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A school hallway with orange brick walls and glass windows, followed by a classroom interior with a green chalkboard and a blue wall-mounted phone organizer.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A sharp synthesized whoosh and a high-pitched comedic stinger accompany the title card. Upbeat, fast-tempo electronic music with a driving drum beat begins immediately. (2) Several female voices enter simultaneously, whispering with high pitch and giggling. One clear female voice speaks excitedly about a secret post. (3) A sudden transition stinger leads to a loud, boisterous male voice shouting 'Nan Chiang Confession Page' followed by a confession. This is accompanied by loud group laughter and the sound of hands clapping. (4) An angry female voice responds with a sharp, rising intonation, complaining about the boys. The BGM remains energetic. (5) Another electronic transition sound occurs. (6) The audio becomes a chaotic mix of multiple overlapping voices in a classroom. A male teacher's voice is heard shouting instructions to 'put phones away.' A male student speaks with a comical, overly romanticized and shaky vocal tone while others grunt in the background. (7) A sudden, dramatic silence occurs as the classroom noise cuts out. A single, low-pitched and authoritative female voice says 'Spoiled brats' with high dominance and flat intonation.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Scene A (Confessions) -> Scene B (Phone Storage) -> Thematic Resolution (Teacher intervention)
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain through a comedic sketch that satirizes stereotypical high school social behaviors in Taiwan, specifically revolving around anonymous social media confessions and the conflict between students and teachers regarding smartphone usage.
